postgresSkuName._comment: Burstable B1ms for dev (~$15/mo). GeneralPurpose D2ds_v5 for prod (~$130/mo). ZoneRedundant HA requires GeneralPurpose or MemoryOptimized.

postgresSkuTier._comment: Burstable for dev. GeneralPurpose for prod (required for ZoneRedundant HA).

postgresHighAvailabilityMode._comment: dev=Disabled (saves ~$35/mo). prod=ZoneRedundant (99.99% SLA). ZoneRedundant requires GeneralPurpose or MemoryOptimized SKU — incompatible with Burstable.

postgresGeoRedundantBackup._comment: dev=Disabled. prod=Enabled for cross-region restore capability.

postgresPublicNetworkAccess._comment: Phase IV: Enabled (AllowAllAzureServices firewall rule). Phase V: Disabled once VNet + private endpoint are configured (ADR-043 Phase V scope).

logAnalyticsDailyCapGB._comment: dev=1 (1 GB/day cap). stage=5. prod=0 (unlimited; set up Azure Monitor alert at 10 GB instead). 0 maps to -1 (unlimited) in the LAW workspaceCapping property.

apiAppCpu._comment: dev: 0.5 acceptable. prod: 1.0 recommended for .NET 9 cold JIT + OTel + FluentMigrator startup path.

apiAppMinReplicas._comment: dev=0 (scale-to-zero saves cost). test=0. stage=1. prod=1 (always available).

apiAppScaleThreshold._comment: Number of concurrent HTTP requests per replica before scaling out.

apiAppRevisionsMode._comment: dev/test=Single. prod=Multiple enables weighted traffic split for zero-downtime deploys.

imageTag._comment: Required. Never use 'latest' in stage or prod. CI must always pass an explicit semver tag or SHA digest. For dev first-time deploys use 'main'.

enablePgBouncer._comment: Recommended: true for all environments. Prevents PG connection exhaustion under load.

enableDefenderForCloud._comment: Enables Defender for Containers + OpenSourceRelationalDatabases at the subscription level. Set false in non-prod to reduce cost.

enablePolicyAssignments._comment: Assigns built-in Azure Policy definitions for KV, PG, and required tags at the RG scope.

enableAlertRules._comment: Creates Azure Monitor metric alert rules for ACA, PG, and KV.

monthlyBudgetUSD._comment: 0 = no budget alert. Set to expected monthly spend. Notifications sent at 80% and 100% to commonTags.Owner.
